title: ForeSay: Tell the Future in Words, Branch the Details in Noise for Precipitation Nowcasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.20815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Precipitation nowcasting involves two distinct scales of uncertainty: macroscopic storm evolution and fine-scale local convective variations. Current generative ensemble methods entangle both scales within independent random noise draws. This coupling causes two practical limitations: every ensemble member must execute the full sampling trajectory from scratch, so an N-member ensemble costs N times a single forecast; moreover, divergent trajectories spatially misalign heavy-rain echoes across members, causing standard pixel-wise averaging to blur critical high-intensity extremes. We present ForeSay, a generative nowcasting framework that decouples macroscopic evolution prediction from local stochastic detail generation. Given historical radar frames, a vision-language model first predicts a textual scenario of future storm dynamics to condition a Rectified Flow generator. translated_title: ForeSay：用文字预述未来，用噪声分化细节的降水临近预报
translated_abstract: 降水临近预报涉及两种不同尺度的不确定性：宏观风暴演变和细尺度局部对流变化。当前的生成式集合预报方法将这两种尺度纠缠在独立的随机噪声采样之中。这种耦合带来了两个实际限制：每个集合成员都必须从头执行完整的采样轨迹，因此N个成员的集合预报成本是单次预报的N倍；此外，发散的轨迹导致各成员之间的强降雨回波在空间上错位，使得标准的逐像素平均会模糊关键的高强度极端降水。我们提出了ForeSay，一个将宏观演变预测与局部随机细节生成解耦的生成式临近预报框架。给定历史雷达帧，视觉-语言模型首先预测未来风暴动力学的文本情景，以此条件化整流流生成器。在这个共享的宏观先验引导下，集合成员共享早期……
tldr: ForeSay通过视觉-语言模型以文本形式预测未来风暴的宏观演变并以此条件化整流流生成器，将宏观演变与局部随机细节解耦，使集合预报成员共享宏观先验，从而大幅降低计算成本并避免像素平均模糊高强度极端降水。
en_tdlr: ForeSay decouples macroscopic storm evolution prediction from local stochastic detail generation by using a vision-language model to describe future storm dynamics in text as a condition for a Rectified Flow generator, enabling ensemble members to share a common macroscopic prior for cheaper and more accurate precipitation nowcasting.
